sources.finding: The official prospective programme identifies the Dutch full-time degree, subjects by block, professional skills and binding study advice threshold of 45 of the first 60 EC. It describes the capstone and individual thesis.

The current student curriculum provides 60 EC in each year, 142.5 EC in the major and 37.5 EC in profiling. The narrative percentages are rounded and the credit table governs. The single second-year choice is profiling, as 30 EC of profiling occur in year three. The 22.5 EC graduation project spans periods three and four and is counted once.
Official programme description establishes governance and organisation inquiry applied to societal problems.

The current Research page establishes year-one quantitative service-delivery research, year-two interviews and observations and year-three independent organisation-based research. Linked USG2020 OSIRIS catalogue returned only the application shell in public retrieval.
The current graduation page refers explicitly to the formal internationalisation requirement under Article 3.5(3) and to the graduation rules in Article 5.3.
The official thesis page specifies individual supervised inquiry, preparation in period three, execution, thesis and presentation in period four.
2026–2027 electives page confirms choice in profiling and the current periods, with optional placement subject to conditions.
Current public regulations landing page links only 2025–2026 and earlier editions. Two likely 2026–2027 PDF routes did not yield documents.

Historical Articles 3.3–3.6 and 4.2 specify 15 EC in international context, 15 advanced EC in profiling, overlap restrictions and a progression chain through introductory and quantitative methods, qualitative research and thesis. The public-issues capstone had a separate prerequisite in organisational study and policy. Annex 1 gives a materially different first-year list, including Dutch society and economics/public finance. Do not apply these exact rules automatically to September 2026 entrants.
Current catalogue link from the programme Research page yielded a JavaScript application shell without publicly extracted entry conditions.
